commits.subject: Merge frozen main into WebFlux and Ratpack API alignment

report.scope: Structural/Git verification only. No target code or tests are executed.

metadata.body:
<!--
CHANGELOG.md is generated from merged pull requests. Do not add an entry unless this PR introduces
a deprecation or breaking change.
-->

Replace WebFlux client list-mutating helpers with filter factories and rename Ratpack's client instrumentation method to `wrap(...)`, matching other library APIs. These are breaking API replacements for 3.0, without deprecated aliases.

```java
// Before
builder.filters(telemetry::addFilter);
ratpackTelemetry.instrument(httpClient);

// After
builder.filter(telemetry.createFilter());
ratpackTelemetry.wrap(httpClient);
```

For Reactor context propagation, replace `builder.filters(telemetry::addFilterAndRegisterReactorHook)` with `builder.filter(telemetry.createFilterAndRegisterReactorHook())`.

Spring Boot customizers add the filter directly; the bean postprocessor still skips clients that already have one. Server filter APIs are unchanged.
metadata.title: Align WebFlux and Ratpack client telemetry APIs for 3.0
